1.

Jesus, our ascended Lord, In Thy name we break the bread And bring forth our heart’s thanksgiving For Thy wondrous death.

2.

This cup, which we bless, Witnesses of Thy precious blood, Which speaks in the sanctuary And gives us holy boldness.

3.

Within “the doors being shut” We may remember Thee in peace; Without, all care is left, The heart’s unrest, the earth’s strife.

4.

To the place which Thou hast chosen, Thy Spirit hath directed our path. In the fellowship of eternal life We worship, praise Thee.

5.

As “brethren” gathered together, Brethren, O Son of God, with Thee, To Thy voice we would hearken, The voice which hath life in itself.

6.

Never more, O Lord Jesus, Shalt Thou taste sorrow and death. In Thy victory Thou hast won for us Peace and life in abundance.

7.

And the life Thou didst win in death Shall fill a world of joy. The fountain with its rich streams Flows forth from Zion’s height.
